decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed installation of a vehicular crossover and carport with up and over door would not maintain the safety of other road and footway users and does not meet the required dimensions and visibility splays for a parking space. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), T.4.4  (Road safety) and T.5.3  (Vehicle crossovers and Hard standings) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and SPG 11 (Roads, Footpaths, Parking and Servicing) of the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed carport will unduly harm the amenity of the property through further reducing the limited private amenity space at the property. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003).

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed installation of a carport, involving the replacement of the existing boundary treatment fails to be of a style and material appropriate to the Bedford Park Conservation Area and therefore fails to preserve and enhance the character of the Conservation Area. The proposal fails to comply with ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003).
description: Proposed off street parking in a carport with roof and up and over door via a drop kerb to provide access to a residential property
